svg.title: Exact points (#1944): the Barrens' Vrang's Game, the arrow on a Sprung Trap after two were checked. Every trap the data knows is a mark of its own on the world map and on the minimap, the checked ones faintest, the lone trap far south fainter as another place they spawn; no region is shaded. The minimap again in the Halo and Hearth skins
